subject: AI for Mumbai launch enquiries
body:
Dear Mr. Nazareth,

Adani Realty has four MahaRERA-registered Mumbai launches in Andheri West and Bhandup West, priced from Rs 1.73 crore to Rs 6.91 crore. Enquiries already arrive through WhatsApp Business, toll-free callbacks and forms, while mixed buyer feedback on delays, pricing and transparency adds manual follow-up.

We help developers answer price, configuration, availability and RERA questions in minutes from approved documents, score leads and write follow-up tasks into the CRM. The first measurable target is median first response under 15 minutes and a 1.5 point lift in qualified lead-to-site-visit conversion.

I would welcome a 30-minute walkthrough with your sales operations team, followed by a three-week read-only pilot on Adani Triumph before any buyer-facing message.

I've attached a one-page summary.

[Your Name]
